_about: Game type (.json) and playlist rules/options. Options, their labels, ranges and choices are the Project Reclaimer 0.9.18 dedicated server's own, confirmed with `dedicated playlist show`; 'modes' lists the base modes an option applies to (all when left out) and 'byMode' what differs in one of them. Trait sets (respawn_traits.*, flag_carrier.*, ...) take the same traits as player.*. Values are the numbers the client writes; 0 is 'Unchanged' for player traits. Not included: mode.score (the same as score_to_win), Forge's edit_mode and editor traits, and Slayer's mode.kill/death/suicide/betrayal (the rules below). Starting weapons are numbered from -3 in the server's order.
_baseModes: value = the name playlists and dedicated.toml use; json = what a game type file's "mode" must hold (from mode-check: CaptureTheFlag, Slayer, Forge, Oddball, KingOfTheHill, Vip, Juggernaut, Territories, Assault, Infection, EscalationSlayer).

rules.label: Score to win
rules.help: Points that win a round, up to 500. 0 = no limit (the time limit ends the round).

rules.label: Kill points
rules.help: Points for a kill, on top of any a script gives.

rules.label: Death points
rules.help: Points for dying, usually 0 or negative.

rules.label: Suicide points
rules.help: Points for killing yourself, usually 0 or negative.

rules.label: Betrayal points
rules.help: Points for killing a teammate, usually 0 or negative.

options.label: Team changing
options.help: What the game type allows. Dedicated servers apply it only with team_changing = "game_type".

options.label: Friendly fire
options.help: A server with friendly_fire = false protects teammates whatever this says.

options.label: Time limit
options.help: Minutes per round. 0 = no time limit.

options.label: Round limit
options.help: Scores reset each round; the total decides the winner.

options.label: Wins for early victory
options.help: Round wins that end the game early. 0 = off.

options.label: Weapon set
options.help: The weapons placed on the map; Default keeps the map's own.

options.label: Vehicle set
options.help: The vehicles placed on the map; Default keeps the map's own.

options.label: Character set
options.help: From 0.9.18. Which characters play: Halo 3's own, a random one each life, or one of the character mods the game includes (the server's customization), in their order.

options.label: Character
options.help: From 0.9.18. A character of the character set: the player's own choice, a random one each life, or a fixed one.

options.label: Red team's character set
options.help: From 0.9.18. Gives each team its own character set in team games.

events.label: When a player kills an enemy

conditions.label: Only if the kill wasn't a melee strike

traitSets.label: Respawn traits
traitSets.help: Traits for the first seconds after spawning (Respawn → traits duration).

traitSets.label: Leader
traitSets.help: Traits of the player or team in the lead.

traitSets.label: In the hill
traitSets.help: Traits of players standing in the hill.

traitSets.label: First infected
traitSets.help: Traits of the players infected at the start of a round.

traitSets.label: Near the VIP
traitSets.help: Traits of the VIP's teammates within its influence radius.

traitSets.label: Red powerup
traitSets.help: Traits a red powerup gives (Powerups → red powerup duration).

_traitSets: Each trait set takes every player.* trait under its own key, e.g. flag_carrier.speed; catalog.js expands them. 'modes' as for options.
